title: Multi-Org Federation: Shared Master Data Synchronization

steps.prompt: A global enterprise operates 4 separate Salesforce orgs (EMEA, APAC, NA, LATAM). Product catalog master records must be synchronized across all orgs within 5 seconds of update. Which architecture delivers lowest operational overhead and real-time scale?

options.label: High-volume Platform Events published via Pub/Sub API to subscribers in each child org
options.rationale: Pub/Sub API provides high-throughput, bidirectionally decoupled event distribution with guaranteed delivery and replay retention across multiple orgs.

options.label: Chained Outbound Messaging with sequential point-to-point Apex REST callouts to each org
options.distractorAntipattern: Point-to-point mesh architectures create cascading timeouts, fragile endpoint maintenance, and high failure rates.
options.rationale: Chained point-to-point callouts introduce N^2 interdependencies, tight operational coupling, and cascading failures if any single regional org experiences latency.

options.label: Salesforce Connect Cross-Org Adapters exposing master Product records via on-demand OData
options.distractorAntipattern: Cross-Org Adapters federate on-demand queries rather than physical synchronization, hitting API quotas and slowing CPQ pricing engines.
options.rationale: Cross-Org Adapters query external orgs on-the-fly via OData rather than caching local records, causing governor limit exhaustion during CPQ quote calculations.
